title: OpCall
description: The one serialized form of a timeline change (API.md section 3.2; R-1: OpCall is the primitive). DRAFT: no producer emits OpCalls yet (journal and Plan carry calls: [] today), so instances are spec-derived, not recorded.

op.description: Qualified operation id, e.g. timeline.opacity or myteam.stagger.

select.description: Selector string or address, as written. null for selection: none.

args.description: Canonical JSON values: moments canonical, durations as '3f' or '0.5s', px numbers.

version.description: The tool version when it ran (filled by the runner).

resolved.description: Stable uids that select (and clip/cut args) resolved to (filled by the runner).
